items.html:
A right-arm fast bowler from Peshawar, Imran Khan made his Test debut against Australia in October 2014 at the age of 27. The promotion to the national team was just reward for extremely consistent domestic performances in the three previous seasons: in 2011-12 he took 61 wickets at 19,70, the next season he took 57 at 21.52, and in 2013-14 he grabbed 52 wickets at 20.73. In his second Test, against Australia in Abu Dhabi, he took 3 for 60, dismissing Chris Rogers, Michael Clarke and Mitchell Marsh.
ESPNcricinfo staff
